questions.stem: On the diagram, sketch the graph of $y=\cos x$ for $0^\circ \leq x \leq 360^\circ$.

The diagram shows two parallel lines intersecting two straight lines.
Find the values of $w$, $x$ and $y$.

figures.alt: NOT TO SCALE. Two parallel lines, both marked with one arrow, run from top-left to bottom-right. A steep line runs from the top of the diagram to the bottom and crosses both parallel lines. A shallow line runs from left to right, crossing both parallel lines and the steep line. Angle w° is at the left parallel where the shallow line crosses it. Angle x° is at the right parallel where the steep line crosses it, above the crossing. Angle y° is where the steep line and the shallow line cross, between the steep line going up and the shallow line going right. Angle 76° is at the left parallel where the steep line crosses it, below the crossing. Angle 158° is at the right parallel where the shallow line crosses it.
